messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT — api-gateway-prod 5xx rate above threshold (5m window) — firing on paging policy. Notifying eng-oncall.
maia: saw this too, dashboards spiking. lots of 502/504s from upstream-model-proxy. Paging now.
sanjay: on it, joining. any customer impact reports yet?
eva: monitoring shows ~8% 5xx across the /v1/generate route, latency also up. A few customers reporting failed requests in Sentry.
maia: quick mitigation idea — throttle incoming burst from the router to the pool of model-proxy instances and enable fallback to smaller model variant for high-QPS tenants. will that help?
sanjay: yes, we can flip the routing weight. rolling a quick traffic steering change now (low-risk):
```
# temporary traffic split
PATCH /routing-config HTTP/1.1
Host: control-plane
Content-Type: application/json
{"route":"/v1/generate","weights":{"model-a-large":0.3,"model-a-small":0.7}}
```
maia: done. also pushing a 30s circuit-breaker to model-proxy for upstream gateway errors.
lucas: adding a short-term rate-limit for anonymous clients to reduce noise: 50r/s -> 20r/s for 15m.
michelle: creating a focused dashboard panel for upstream_5xx_by_provider and gateway_timeouts. linking to the thread.
ops-bot: NOTE: deploys are currently allowed in prod window. no recent deploys flagged in last 30m.
sanjay: looking through logs — majority of 504s point to model-host-3 timing out while contacting external provider X for embeddings. correlation with increased embedding requests from a single partner.
eva: can we temporarily reroute that partner to our fallback embedding provider? that's low-risk for short window.
maia: good call. on it — updating routing map for tenant partner-omega.
maia: partner-omega now on fallback-embeddings (gradual). seeing drop in target 5xx from ~18% of errors to ~9% so far.
sanjay: creating incident ticket INF-2026-498 in tracker for postmortem and followups (alert tuning, dashboard, runbook update).
michelle: for alert noise, propose raising the 5xx alert from 1% -> 3% on 5m window and require sustained for 10m before paging. also add new alert split by upstream provider to catch provider-specific failures.
lucas: +1. also add temporary suppression for low-severity 5xx from internal smoke tests during mitigation.
maia: will update runbook with explicit steps: 1) identify upstream provider, 2) apply tenant-level fallback/reroute, 3) apply traffic steering to smaller model variant, 4) add circuit-breaker, 5) escalate to infra if host-level OOMs.
sanjay: handoff note for night oncall (eva -> night): if upstream provider X > 10% or gateway timeouts persist > 15m escalate to platform+vendor-eng. follow-up ticket INF-2026-499 assigned to platform.
eva: summary for customer-facing comms: short-lived elevated error rates on /v1/generate due to upstream provider timeouts. mitigation: traffic steering and fallback applied. most customers recovered within ~12m. drafting a status update.
oncall-bot: Handoff reminder — schedule a 10m sync on standby channel for incoming night oncall. handoff_ts=2145001700
michelle: after-action items:
- INF-2026-498: postmortem + timeline
- INF-2026-500: add dashboard panels (upstream_5xx_by_provider, gateway_timeouts, per-tenant error rate)
- INF-2026-501: alert rule changes (5xx threshold, sustained window, provider split)
- INF-2026-502: synthetic check against provider X every 5m
maia: implementing alert rule change now in playbooks repo. patch preview:
```
alerts:
  - name: gateway_5xx_rate
    expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5..",route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/v1/generate"}[5m]))
    for: 10m
    threshold: 0.03
    labels:
      severity: page
      scope: per_route
```
sanjay: looks good. remember to instrument provider dimension so we can suppress provider-only incidents from paging until we hit multi-provider or customer-impact thresholds.
eva: logs show a small spike in retries causing queue growth in model-proxy — will add a short-term backoff at edge to reduce retries.
maia: monitoring shows 5xx back down to ~0.9% after all mitigations. switching alert to warning-only for 30m to avoid noise while we validate.
ops-bot: INCIDENT: resolved (mitigations applied, traffic steering & fallbacks in place). closing paging loop.
maia: closing thread here. will attach timeline + graph snapshots to INF-2026-498 and schedule a 30m postmortem sync tomorrow 11:00 PT. :thumbsup:
